app.name: KisanNiti
app.tagline: Fair selling plans for Farmer Producer Organizations
app.description: Decision support for FPO post-harvest selling

status.title: System status
status.demoBanner: {mode} — fictional FPO data; not real farmers

issues.NOT_READY: the database structure does not match the latest code

errors.forbidden: You do not have permission for this.
errors.internal: Something went wrong on our side. Quote the reference when you report it.
errors.network: The server could not be reached. Try again.
errors.csrf: The page is out of date. Reload it and try again.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.intro: Use the account your FPO administrator gave you.
signIn.throttled: Too many attempts. Try again in {minutes} minutes.
signIn.demoNote: This is a demonstration with fictional accounts.

changePassword.title: Change your password
changePassword.intro: You must set a new password before you continue.
changePassword.mismatch: The two new passwords are not the same.
changePassword.weak: This password is not acceptable. Avoid common passwords and your username, and use at least 10 characters.
changePassword.hint: At least 10 characters. Several ordinary words together work well.

home.soon: Prices, storage, plans and messages will appear here as they are built.

users.title: Users
users.intro: People who can sign in for your FPO. Passwords are never shown, except a temporary one, once.
users.name: Name
users.created: User created. Give this temporary password to them now; it will not be shown again.
users.confirmReset: Reset the password of {name}? They will be signed out.
users.confirmDeactivate: Deactivate {name}? They will be signed out and cannot sign in.
users.usernameHint: Letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore; 3 to 64 characters.
users.noPermission: You do not have permission to manage users.

members.title: Members
members.intro: The farmers of your FPO. Contact details come later, with the consent controls.
members.name: Name
members.noWrite: You can view members but not change them.

lots.title: Lots and stock
lots.intro: Each lot is one crop owned by one member. The quantities come from a ledger that never rounds and never goes below zero; they cannot be typed in.
lots.refused: Refused: this would make the stock negative.
lots.badQuantity: Write the quantity with exactly three decimals, for example 1250.000.
lots.sensorHint: Link a sensor so the storage condition can be used in plans

prices.title: Market prices
prices.intro: Daily prices reported by the mandis (AGMARKNET), for Paddy(Basmati) in Punjab, and the official support prices. These are mandi-level prices, not the price a farmer received.

status.PENDING_HAND_CHECK: Not yet checked by a person

prices.pendingWarning: These prices are shown with a warning: a person has not yet compared a sample with the AGMARKNET website, and the rule for rows without a date is not yet confirmed. Do not use them for any claim yet.
prices.blankDate: Date taken from the row above
prices.noData: No price dataset has been imported yet.

flagNames.DUPLICATE_KEY: two rows for the same day

devices.title: Storage sensors
devices.intro: Each sensor sits in one place and reports temperature and humidity. The category is an experimental approximation of conditions that favour mould and insects at that one point. It is not measured spoilage.

placements.AMBIENT: In the air of the shed

reasons.NO_ASSIGNMENT: The sensor has not been placed yet.
reasons.NOT_IN_GRAIN: The sensor is not in the grain, so the grain condition cannot be judged.
reasons.SETTLING: The sensor was only just placed; the first 6 hours are ignored while it settles.
reasons.STALE: No fresh reading in the last 15 minutes.
reasons.LOW_COVERAGE: Fewer than three quarters of the expected readings arrived in the last 24 hours.

insects.INSECT_FAVOURABLE: Warm enough for insects to be active

adjust.COLD_BELOW_10C_LOWERED: Lowered one step because it is below 10 °C
adjust.WARM_25C_RAISED: Raised one step because it is 25 °C or warmer with humidity of 60% or more

devices.limits: 65% and 70% are the limits for medium and high
devices.noAssessment: No assessment yet; the job runs every hour.
devices.label: Experimental approximation, not measured spoilage
devices.confirmDeactivate: Stop accepting readings from {id}? Its history stays.

plans.title: Plans
plans.intro: A plan proposes which lots to sell, in which mandi and on which day, and says why. It is only a proposal: nothing is reserved, sold or sent until a manager approves it, which is a later step.
plans.forecastLabel: Baseline forecast, not validated on held-out data
plans.notChecked: This outlook is a simple placeholder. It is not advice and it has not been tested.
plans.origin: Counted from the newest price day: {date}
plans.noRange: no range: too few past cases ({n})
plans.noOutlook: No outlook is available for this variety.
plans.mandiNote: Only mandis with at least 5 recent price days can be chosen.
plans.transport: Transport cost, ₹ per quintal (your own figure, 0.00 if none)
plans.basis: usually {basis} ₹ against the all-mandi price ({days} days)
plans.incrementHint: Lots are planned in whole steps of this size, for example 100.000

issues.VARIETY_NOT_FORECAST: Only 1121 and Basmati 1509 can be planned.
issues.HORIZON_NOT_ALLOWED: Choose at least one of 1, 7 or 14 days.
issues.MANDI_NOT_ELIGIBLE: None of the chosen mandis has enough recent prices.
issues.TRANSPORT_INVALID: Write the transport cost with two decimals, for example 35.00.
issues.INCREMENT_INVALID: Write the selling step with three decimals, for example 100.000.
issues.NO_ELIGIBLE_LOTS: No lot of this variety has stock of at least one selling step. Register lots first.
issues.NO_PRICE_DATA: No price data has been imported.
issues.INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY: Not enough price days this season to make an outlook.
issues.PRICE_NOT_POSITIVE: The forecast price for a mandi would not be positive; check the data.
issues.SYNTHETIC_INPUT_IN_LIVE: Demonstration data cannot be used in live mode.

plans.notApproved: This is a proposal. Nothing is reserved, sold or sent. Approval by a manager is the next step and is not built yet.

notProposedReasons.OPTIMALITY_NOT_PROVEN: The planner could not prove its answer is the best within the time allowed.
notProposedReasons.TECHNICAL_FAILURE: The planner failed. Nothing should be done with this plan.

warnings.PRICE_DATASET_UNCHECKED: The price data has not been checked by a person yet.
warnings.PRICE_DATA_OLDER_THAN_TODAY: The newest price is {days} days old (from {origin_date}); dates are counted from that day.
warnings.RANGE_NOT_AVAILABLE: No price range for {horizons} days ahead: too few past cases.
warnings.STORAGE_ALL_UNKNOWN: No lot has a known storage condition, so storage is not used in this plan.
warnings.NOT_ALL_STOCK_ALLOCATED: {scheduled_kg} of {participating_kg} kg is planned; the rest is left over.
warnings.SYNTHETIC_DEMO_DATA: Demonstration data: fictional farmers, not real.
warnings.PRICE_SAME_ON_ALL_DATES: The forecast is the same on every date, so dates are not chosen by price.

plans.share: Share of each farmer's stock that is planned

reasons.VARIETY_NOT_MATCHING: its variety is not the one planned
reasons.ASSESSMENT_OLD: the last sensor assessment is more than 2 hours old
reasons.NO_ASSIGNMENT: the sensor has not been placed
reasons.NOT_IN_GRAIN: the sensor is not in the grain

explain.FORECAST_METHOD: Prices ahead are taken to be the same as the newest price day (the simplest, 'naive' rule).
explain.FORECAST_NOT_VALIDATED: This forecast has not been tested on held-out data. Treat it as a placeholder, not as advice.
explain.PRICE_DATA_AGE: The newest price is from {origin_date}, {days} days ago.
explain.MANDI_BASIS: {mandi} usually pays {basis_inr_per_quintal} ₹ per quintal compared with the all-mandi price (from {days_used} recent days).
explain.TRANSPORT_AS_ENTERED: Transport to {mandi}: {inr_per_quintal} ₹ per quintal, as you entered.
explain.WAITING_COST_NOT_MODELLED: The cost of waiting (storage loss, interest) is not included yet.
explain.STORAGE_PRIORITY: Lot {lot} is at {category}; the plan gives it priority to be sold early.
explain.STORAGE_UNKNOWN: Lot {lot}: storage condition not known ({reason}); it gets no priority.
explain.INCREMENT_REMAINDER: Lot {lot}: {remainder_kg} kg is left over because lots are sold in steps of {increment_kg} kg.
explain.FAIRNESS_RULE: Fairness rule: the farmer with the smallest planned share is helped first. The lowest planned share is {lowest_fulfilment} (1.0 would be all of the stock).
explain.DATE_BY_TIE_BREAK: Because the forecast is the same on every date, the date is chosen by a fixed rule (the earliest), not by price.
explain.OUTCOME: Planned {allocated_kg} kg; expected return after transport {net_return_inr} ₹.
